usedFor: SzybkiSMS sends texts through your SzybkiSMS account with “Send SMS” and “Send MMS”, and “Add Sender” sets a sender name.

bestTemplate.name: “Send SMS” in SzybkiSMS
bestTemplate.why: It sends a text to one or more phone numbers.

watchOut: “Send SMS” reaches someone outside the business, so it waits in Needs you for your approval.
